landmarks.snippet: Modern thermal spa using the same spring that supplied the Romans. Its rooftop pool offers panoramic views over Bath’s Georgian skyline, a luxury that continues a 2,000-year bathing tradition.

landmarks.name: TimeLine Theatre
landmarks.snippet: TimeLine Theatre is a professional theater company in Chicago. It matters for its focus on history-based plays and social issues. The most interesting fact is that it was founded in 1997 and stages works set within the last 100 years.

landmarks.name: Times Square
landmarks.snippet: Times Square is a major commercial and tourist hub in Manhattan, known worldwide for its bright lights and New Year's Eve celebrations. It originated as Longacre Square and was renamed in 1904 after The New York Times moved there.

landmarks.name: Tirso de Molina
landmarks.snippet: Tirso de Molina is a prominent public artwork honoring the Golden Age playwright in Madrid's plaza. It matters as a tribute to Spanish literary heritage. The most interesting fact is the statue depicts him with a quill, symbolizing his creation of the Don Juan legend.

landmarks.name: Tonhalle
landmarks.snippet: Tonhalle is Zurich's main concert hall opened in 1895, home to the Tonhalle-Orchester. It matters as a cultural venue for classical music. The most interesting fact is its neoclassical architecture modeled after the Gewandhaus in Leipzig.

landmarks.name: Toormina Library
landmarks.snippet: Toormina Library serves as the community’s lending and learning hub. It matters for free public access to knowledge. The most interesting fact is its outdoor reading garden features native plant labels in Gumbaynggirr language.

landmarks.name: Totstalahoeetska
landmarks.snippet: Totstalahoeetska is an archaeological site. It matters as evidence of ancient indigenous settlement in the region. The most interesting fact is that it preserves remnants of pre-Columbian Native American cultures.

landmarks.name: Uhrenmuseum Beyer Zürich
landmarks.snippet: Uhrenmuseum Beyer Zürich is a private watch museum showcasing timepieces from 1400 to today. It matters for documenting Swiss horology heritage. The single most interesting fact is its collection of the oldest working cuckoo clock from 1570.

landmarks.name: United We Stand
landmarks.snippet: An outdoor public artwork symbolizing unity and resilience in the community. It matters as a local cultural landmark promoting civic pride. The most interesting fact is that it was created in response to national events, becoming a gathering spot for reflection.

landmarks.name: Uptown Theatre
landmarks.snippet: Uptown Theatre is a historic movie palace in Chicago. It matters as a landmark of early 20th-century entertainment architecture. The most interesting fact is that it opened in 1925 with 4,381 seats, making it one of the largest theaters in the US at the time.

landmarks.name: Väterchen Timofei
landmarks.snippet: Väterchen Timofei is a memorial dedicated to a historical figure in Munich. It matters as a local landmark honoring cultural contributions. The single most interesting fact is its connection to Russian immigrant stories in the city's past.

landmarks.name: Vigeland Hus
landmarks.snippet: Vigeland Hus is a museum in Mandal dedicated to sculptor Gustav Vigeland's early life and works. It matters for linking the famous artist to his birthplace. The single most interesting fact is that Vigeland lived here as a child before moving to Oslo and creating his famous park.

landmarks.name: Vodak-East Side Branch Library
landmarks.snippet: Vodak-East Side Branch Library is a historic public library serving Chicago's East Side community. It matters for preserving local immigrant history and education access. The most interesting fact is it was named after a Slovenian-American benefactor who funded its construction in the 1920s.

landmarks.name: Wall of Remembrance
landmarks.snippet: An elongated granite wall inscribed with the names of thousands who perished during the country’s authoritarian period, it forms part of the Bantayog grounds. Visitors often leave flowers or messages at the wall.

landmarks.name: War Memorial
landmarks.snippet: The War Memorial honors local service members. It matters as a focal point for remembrance ceremonies. The most interesting fact is its ANZAC Day dawn service draws the entire community at sunrise.

landmarks.name: War memorial
landmarks.snippet: This War memorial commemorates local service personnel from conflicts spanning the Boer War to Afghanistan. A distinctive sandstone cenotaph bears the names of 87 fallen soldiers from the district.

landmarks.name: Watertown History Museum
landmarks.snippet: Watertown History Museum preserves local heritage through exhibits on the town's industrial past and community life. It matters as the central repository for Watertown's documented history since the 19th century.

landmarks.name: Watertown Library Association
landmarks.snippet: Watertown Library Association operates as the town's historic public library. It matters for providing continuous educational resources to residents for over a century.

landmarks.name: West Ham Baptist Tabernacle
landmarks.snippet: West Ham Baptist Tabernacle is a prominent Nonconformist chapel built in 1881. It served as a major center for religious and community life in Victorian East London. The building hosted influential preachers and social reform meetings.

landmarks.name: Whiteleaf Barrow
landmarks.snippet: Whiteleaf Barrow is a Neolithic long barrow near Princes Risborough. It matters as one of Britain's earliest burial monuments from around 3500 BC. The most interesting fact is that excavations revealed a wooden mortuary structure with human remains.

landmarks.name: Whiteleaf Cross
landmarks.snippet: Whiteleaf Cross is a historic chalk hill figure overlooking Princes Risborough. It matters as a prominent local landmark and scheduled monument. The single most interesting fact is that its age and original purpose remain unknown despite extensive study.
